name: Mike Selmer
residence: Laramie, Albany County (he wrote that he moved to Wyoming in 2010; 2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
occupation: Retired business owner and blue-collar tradesman; he has described himself as a master electrician, master cabinetmaker, and home builder (2024 WyoFile questionnaire and the already-sourced campaign / League of Women Voters profile text on this record)
background: In his 2024 WyoFile questionnaire, Mike Selmer wrote that he and his wife live in a home they built in 2017–2018 in Laramie, that he was born in Maryland, that they moved to Wyoming in 2010, and that he would be 68 on Election Day 2024.

He wrote that he was a blue-collar worker and a business owner for most of his working life, including managing a workforce of more than 30 employees, and that in recent years he has served on boards of organizations and nonprofits. Already-sourced profile text on this record, drawn from his campaign materials and the League of Women Voters of Albany County 2024 general-election voter guide, also describes him as a master electrician, master cabinetmaker, and home builder, and as a cancer survivor. Ballotpedia records that he was born in Baltimore, Maryland, and lists affiliations including the Wyoming Food Coalition, Alliance for Renewable Energy-Laramie, and the Albany County Democratic Party.
